name: paperpilot
description: Paperpilot V2 - research discovery and manuscript analysis

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@paperpilot/shared && npm run build --workspace=@paperpilot/api && npm run build --workspace=@paperpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@paperpilot/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@paperpilot/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@paperpilot/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
